acceptance_checks: protect_branch emits require_code_owner_reviews: false when the target config omits defaults.required_code_owner_review.
protect_branch emits require_code_owner_reviews: true only when defaults.required_review and defaults.required_code_owner_review are both true.
protect_branch emits require_code_owner_reviews: false when defaults.required_review is false, even if defaults.required_code_owner_review is true.
required_approving_review_count is unchanged in every case: 1 when required_review is true, 0 when it is false.
configured_required_code_owner_review returns False for an absent key, honors an explicit true, and returns False whenever configured_required_review is False (tests/test_config_loading.py).
tests/test_branch_protection_payload.py no longer asserts require_code_owner_reviews is true at review_count=1, and its cases pass the code-owner value explicitly.
The shipped .shiki/config.yaml contains required_code_owner_review: false under defaults.
doctor.github.branch_protection is fail when config requires code-owner review and live protection lacks it.
doctor.github.branch_protection is warn when live protection requires code-owner review and config does not, and its remediation text names the PR-author deadlock.
doctor.github.branch_protection is pass when the configured and live values agree in either direction.

A MergeGate PR snapshot whose sole APPROVED review is the GitHub Actions bot, authored by the repo owner, passes enforce_review_policy; the existing 'Required review is missing' case in scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh still fails as before.
docs/agents/decision-control.md no longer asserts that branch protection must require code owner reviews, and states that multi-maintainer adopters opt in.
docs/agents/bootstrap-command.md and docs/agents/shiki-doctor.md describe the opt-in setting rather than unconditional enforcement.
docs/adr/SADR-0021-code-owner-review-enforcement-is-opt-in.md exists and records the decision, the SADR-0013 tension, and the multi-maintainer trade-off.
python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py passes; python3 -m unittest discover tests passes; scripts/test_shiki_init.sh, scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh and scripts/test_shiki_doctor.sh pass.
scope: Add defaults.required_code_owner_review to Shiki config and drive protect_branch's require_code_owner_reviews from it instead of from review_count; name the key as governance-critical in the installer; teach doctor the fail/warn matrix; and record the decision in SADR-0021 with the governance docs corrected.
title: Make GitHub code-owner review enforcement opt-in
